<a id="schema-errorcode"></a>

## `ErrorCode`

`"INVALID_REQUEST"`, `"LOCAL_ACCESS_DENIED"`, `"AUTH_REQUIRED"`, `"KEYRING_LOCKED"`, `"RUNTIME_MISSING"`, `"INTEGRATION_RESTRICTED"`, `"PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE"`, `"CAPABILITY_UNKNOWN"`, `"CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED"`, `"OPTION_UNSUPPORTED"`, `"SELECTION_STALE"`, `"RATE_LIMITED"`, `"BILLING_CONSENT_REQUIRED"`, `"APPROVAL_REQUIRED"`, `"SESSION_ROUTE_MISMATCH"`, `"EVENT_GAP"`, `"PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE"`, `"STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE"`, `"TIMEOUT"`, `"CANCELLED"`, `"CONFLICT"`, `"FRAME_TOO_LARGE"`, `"NOT_FOUND"`, `"NOT_IMPLEMENTED"` OR `"RESUME_UNAVAILABLE"`


### variant 1



`"INVALID_REQUEST"`, `"LOCAL_ACCESS_DENIED"`, `"AUTH_REQUIRED"`, `"KEYRING_LOCKED"`, `"RUNTIME_MISSING"`, `"INTEGRATION_RESTRICTED"`, `"PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE"`, `"CAPABILITY_UNKNOWN"`, `"CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED"`, `"OPTION_UNSUPPORTED"`, `"SELECTION_STALE"`, `"RATE_LIMITED"`, `"BILLING_CONSENT_REQUIRED"`, `"APPROVAL_REQUIRED"`, `"SESSION_ROUTE_MISMATCH"`, `"EVENT_GAP"`, `"PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE"`, `"STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE"`, `"TIMEOUT"`, `"CANCELLED"`, `"CONFLICT"`, `"FRAME_TOO_LARGE"`, `"NOT_FOUND"`, `"NOT_IMPLEMENTED"`


### variant 2

A suspended conversation cannot be continued (identity, route, model,
workspace or native history changed or is gone). Never replaced by a
fresh conversation; the host decides whether to start over.

`"RESUME_UNAVAILABLE"`

<a id="schema-hostmcpserver"></a>

## `HostMcpServer`

A loopback streamable-HTTP MCP server run by the host application.

`url` must be `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/...` or `http://[::1]:<port>/...`.
The bearer token is a host secret: it is never logged, echoed, or placed on
a command line, and `Debug` redacts it.

`object`

| Field | Required | Wire type | Constraints / description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `allowedTools` | yes | array of `string` | Tool names (`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$`) the agent may call on this server. |
| `bearerToken` | yes | `string` | 32-512 printable ASCII characters. |
| `name` | yes | `string` | `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$` |
| `url` | yes | `string` | — |

Additional properties are forbidden by this schema.

<a id="schema-issuekind"></a>

## `IssueKind`

`"auth_required"`, `"auth_expired"`, `"keyring_locked"`, `"unsupported_client"`, `"usage_unavailable"`, `"quota_exhausted"`, `"rate_limited"`, `"adapter_failure"`, `"storage_unavailable"`, `"permission_denied"`, `"service_unavailable"`, `"configuration_invalid"`, `"unknown"`


<a id="schema-issueseverity"></a>

## `IssueSeverity`

`"info"`, `"warning"`, `"error"`, `"critical"`


<a id="schema-issuestate"></a>

## `IssueState`

`"open"` OR `"acknowledged"` OR `"snoozed"` OR `"resolved"`


### variant 1

Still observed or not yet verified as recovered.

`"open"`


### variant 2

The user has seen it; it is still unhealthy.

`"acknowledged"`


### variant 3

Notifications are suppressed until this time. The issue is still open.

`"snoozed"`


### variant 4

A later observation verified recovery. Dismissal alone never sets this.

`"resolved"`
